_comment: NOT PART OF THE RST JAIPUR 2026 DATA-USE ROUND. This describes a session-feedback survey, which is a different instrument from the deployed flow (flows/RST2026_jaipur_data_use.json, the ARM1/ARM2 data-use experiment). Do not submit it for that round - submitting freezes the wording forever. Use rst2026_intro.json and rst2026_close.json instead.
Closing template for the 2026 India Research Staff Training feedback survey.
Sent as a template rather than free-form because the close fires after the
respondent has finished answering, which may be hours or days after they
started. A participant who begins Monday evening and finishes Wednesday is
outside the 24-hour window, and a free-form close would fail silently with
error 63016 - they would answer every question and hear nothing back.
The 2023 flow had no closing template at all.
Follows the house formula used by end1_msj / end2_msj2, which Meta approved
as UTILITY: thank, close warmly, sign off as the IPA team. English here
rather than the Spanish original, to match the RST audience.
The 'please do not reply' line is included on the assumption that nobody
monitors the WhatsApp number once the training round closes - the pattern
rifa_wa_cierre uses. Drop that paragraph if someone is watching the inbox,
since telling people not to reply when they could is worse than silence.

twilio/text.body:
Thank you for sharing your feedback on the 2026 India Research Staff Training.

Your answers have been recorded and will be used to improve future sessions.

This channel is now closed and is not monitored, so please do not reply to this chat.

_IPA Team_
